text: One team used every colour... the other used none. Pick your winner.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Rumi tells of a contest. A Sultan gives two houses... one to Chinese artists, one to Greek.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The Chinese gather every kind of paint... and cover their walls with wonders.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The Greeks used no colours at all. They just cleaned... and polished.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Burnishing them... till they were as clear and bright as the heavens.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Judging day. The Sultan inspects both. The painted house is much admired. But in the end...
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The Greek house carried off the palm.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Their shining walls caught every colour in the room... in endless shades.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In essence... what your heart truly knows beats what you only learned from books.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: We try to grow by adding. More apps. More courses. More noise. Sometimes... we grow by clearing.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Painting looks like progress. Polishing looks like nothing... until the light hits.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: This morning, remove one thing before adding anything. One tab. One app. One grudge.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: What would you clear first? One word, in the comments.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... keep your wall clean.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
